title: workbench.manifest.json
description: Manifest for @sovereignfs/workbench (wb): the repos in a workbench and how to work with them.

name.description: A display name for this workbench.

defaults.description: Settings every repo inherits unless it sets its own.

dir.description: Where pods are created, relative to the workbench root.

portBase.description: First port of pod 1's port block.

blockSize.description: Ports reserved per pod. Pod n's block starts at portBase + (n - 1) * blockSize.

defaults.description: Ports or ranges `wb kill-port` targets when given none.

relPath.description: A path relative to the workbench root, without '..'.

branch.description: The branch pull and clear keep up to date. Default: main.

install.description: How `wb pod create` installs dependencies: "auto" (from the lockfile; the default), a package manager (runs "<pm> install" when there's a package.json), false (never), or a command as an argv array.

carry.description: Untracked files copied from the main checkout into pods and across `pull --reset`. Default: [".env"].

url.description: Clone URL. SSH URLs are rewritten to HTTPS with --https.

path.description: Where the main checkout lives, relative to the workbench root. Unique; repos are addressed by it.

skip.description: Left out of `wb init`; clone it with `wb pull <path> --reset`.

legacy.description: Retired: gets no pods and may reuse another entry's id.

prefix.description: Pod directory name prefix; pods are <prefix><n>. Default: "<id>-". Must not end in a digit.

ports.description: Env vars that get the pod's ports: ports[i] = block start + i. Literal localhost:<default> references are rewritten too.
